headline: Six resolutions appropriating funds for capital projects, including $4,181,173.39 for a lead hazard reduction grant.
summary: Six resolutions would amend the FY2027 and FY2021 Community Improvement Programs. Seven budget authorizations are also listed for approval, subject to adoption of the related resolutions.
items: Six resolutions amending capital improvement programs and appropriating funds for city projects
Seven budget authorizations, including Weston Road & S. Willow Street Intersection Improvements
item_action_words: the Resolutions ought to pass and be Enrolled
the Budget Authorizations be approved subject to final adoption of related Resolutions
plain_text:
COMMITTEE ON FINANCE 
December 1, 2026 Upon Recess of the BMA 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Mayor and All Aldermen 
 
AGENDA 
 
The Mayor calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. Resolutions: (A motion is in order to read by titles only.) 
 
“Amending the FY2003 and FY2021 Community Improvement Program, 
authorizing, appropriating and transferring funds in the amount of One Hundred 
Eighty-Nine Thousand Two Hundred Seventy-Nine Dollars and Twenty-Five 
Cents ($189,279.25) for the FY2021CIP 713221 Weston Road & S. Willow 
Street Intersection Improvements.” 
 
“Amending the FY2027 Community Improvement Program, authorizing and 
appropriating funds in the amount Three Thousand Seven Hundred Six Dollars 
($3,706) for the FY2027 CIP C040080127 Document Preservation Project.” 
 
“Amending the FY2027 Community Improvement Program, authorizing and 
appropriating funds in the amount Fifteen Thousand Dollars ($15,000) for the 
FY2027 CIP C160060227 Aged and Infirmed Shelter Project.” 
 
“Amending the FY2027 Community Improvement Program, authorizing and 
appropriating funds in the amount of Four Million One Hundred Eighty One 
Thousand One Hundred Seventy Three Dollars and Thirty-Nine Cents 
($4,181,173.39) for the FY2027 CIP C200060427 2026 Lead Hazard Reduction 
Grant.” 
 
“Amending the FY2027 Community Improvement Program, authorizing and 
appropriating funds in the amount of Nine Hundred Thousand ($900,000) for the 
FY2027 CIP C200060527 2026 Lead Hazard Reduction Grant - HH 
Supplement.”
December 1, 2026 COMMITTEE ON FINANCE 
Page 2 of 2 
 
“Amending the FY2027 Community Improvement Program, authorizing and 
appropriating funds in the amount of Ninety-Three Thousand Dollars 
($93,000)for the FY2027 CIP C330040527 FY27 STOP Violence Against 
Women Act (VAWA).” 
If the Committee so desires, a motion would be in order that the 
Resolutions ought to pass and be Enrolled. 
 
    
2. Budget Authorizations: 
• 713221 Weston Road & S. Willow Street Intersection Improvements 
• 713303 South Willow Street Area Improvements 
• C040080127 Document Preservation Project 
• C160060227 Aged and Infirmed Shelter Project 
• C200060427 2026 Lead Hazard Reduction Grant 
• C200060527 2026 Lead Hazard Reduction Grant - HH Supplement 
• C330040527 FY27 STOP Violence Against Women Act (VAWA) 
If the Committee so desires, a motion would be in order that the Budget 
Authorizations be approved subject to final adoption of related 
Resolutions. 
    
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
